text:
Jason Robertson is in a contract year by choice. Last summer he declined a long-term deal with Seattle that would have completed a sign-and-trade, then signed a one-year, $12 million contract with Dallas, as NHL.com and The Associated Press reported. Extension talks can't produce a deal until January 1, so every month of this season is part of the negotiation.

He's making his case. Nine goals and 19 points in 17 games, including a hat trick in 5:20 against Washington, the third-fastest in Stars history per NHL.com's Tom Gulitti. He has seven goals in his last ten.

Some of it will cool: 9 goals on 6.4 expected, and Dallas has scored 5.1 more than expected with him on. But the chance creation is real. Evolving-Hockey had him 14th among 401 forwards last season, driving expected goals at the 98th percentile, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking puts his chances from the home-plate area in the 90th percentile. A 45-goal scorer last season, he's tracking close to it again. Watch the price go up with every one.
headline: Robertson is playing for his next contract
